const ROOM_ID = 'sina_office_greenhouse';
const MS_PER_DAY = 86400000;

const CORS_HEADERS = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET, POST, OPTIONS',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type'
};

const toPersianNum = (num) =>
  String(num).replace(/\d/g, (d) => 'Û°Û±Û²Û³Û´ÛµÛ¶Û·Û¸Û¹'[Number(d)]);

const formatPersianToday = () => {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR-u-ca-persian', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Tehran',
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    year: 'numeric'
  }).format(new Date());
};

const formatTehranTime = () => {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR', {
    timeZone: 'Asia/Tehran',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit'
  }).format(new Date());
};

// Û±. Ø¯Ø±ÛŒØ§ÙØª Ùˆ Ø°Ø®ÛŒØ±Ù‡ ÙˆØ¶Ø¹ÛŒØª Ú¯Ù„Ø®Ø§Ù†Ù‡ Ø¯Ø± Supabase
async function loadStateFromSupabase(env) {
  const res = await fetch(
    `${env.SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/greenhouse_state?room_id=eq.${ROOM_ID}&select=payload`,
    {
      headers: {
        apikey: env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
        Authorization: `Bearer ${env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY}`
      }
    }
  );
  if (!res.ok) return null;
  const rows = await res.json();
  if (!Array.isArray(rows) || rows.length === 0) return null;
  return rows[0].payload;
}

async function saveStateToSupabase(env, payload) {
  await fetch(`${env.SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/greenhouse_state`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      apikey: env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
      Authorization: `Bearer ${env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Prefer: 'resolution=merge-duplicates'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      room_id: ROOM_ID,
      payload,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    })
  });
}

// Û². Ù…ÙˆØªÙˆØ± Ù…Ø­Ø§Ø³Ø¨Ø§Øª Ø¹Ù„Ù…ÛŒ Ø±Ø·ÙˆØ¨Øª Ø¨Ø³ØªØ±ØŒ Ø¢Ø¨ÛŒØ§Ø±ÛŒ Ùˆ ØºØ¨Ø§Ø±Ù¾Ø§Ø´ÛŒ Ø±ÙˆÛŒ Ø³Ø±ÙˆØ±
function evaluatePlantServer(plant, radiatorOn) {
  let effectiveCycle = plant.waterCycleDays ? plant.waterCycleDays : 7;
  if (radiatorOn && plant.statusType !== 'locked' && plant.statusType !== 'recovery') {
    effectiveCycle = Math.max(2, Math.round(effectiveCycle * 0.75));
  }
  let elapsed = plant.daysSinceWater ? plant.daysSinceWater : 0;
  if (typeof plant.lastWateredAt === 'number' && plant.lastWateredAt > 0) {
    elapsed = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - plant.lastWateredAt) / MS_PER_DAY));
  }
  const daysRemaining = Math.max(0, effectiveCycle - elapsed);
  const needsWateringNow = plant.statusType !== 'recovery' && effectiveCycle - elapsed <= 0;

  const mistCycle = plant.mistCycleDays !== undefined ? plant.mistCycleDays : 0;
  let elapsedMist = plant.daysSinceMist !== undefined ? plant.daysSinceMist : 0;
  if (typeof plant.lastMistedAt === 'number' && plant.lastMistedAt > 0) {
    elapsedMist = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - plant.lastMistedAt) / MS_PER_DAY));
  }
  const needsMistingNow = Boolean(
    plant.needsMistToday ? true : mistCycle > 0 && elapsedMist >= mistCycle
  );

  const rawMoisture = Math.round(((effectiveCycle - elapsed) / Math.max(1, effectiveCycle)) * 92 + 8);
  const radiatorPenalty = radiatorOn && elapsed > 0 ? 6 : 0;
  const moisturePercent = needsWateringNow
    ? Math.min(22, Math.max(8, rawMoisture - radiatorPenalty))
    : Math.max(12, Math.min(100, rawMoisture - radiatorPenalty));

  return {
    effectiveCycle,
    elapsed,
    daysRemaining,
    needsWateringNow,
    needsMistingNow,
    needsQuarterTurn: Boolean(plant.needsRotation),
    moisturePercent
  };
}

// Û³. ØªÙˆØ§Ø¨Ø¹ Ø§Ø±ØªØ¨Ø§Ø·ÛŒ Ø¨Ø§ Telegram Bot API (Ø§Ø±Ø³Ø§Ù„ØŒ ÙˆÛŒØ±Ø§ÛŒØ´ Ø¯Ø±Ø¬Ø§ØŒ Ø­Ø°Ù Ú©ÛŒØ¨ÙˆØ±Ø¯ Ù‚Ø¯ÛŒÙ…ÛŒ Ùˆ Ø«Ø¨Øª Ù…Ù†Ùˆ)
async function tgApiCall(token, method, payload) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`https://api.telegram.org/bot${token}/${method}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
    return await res.json();
  } catch {
    return { ok: false };
  }
}

async function clearOldReplyKeyboardSilently(token, chatId) {
  const sent = await tgApiCall(token, 'sendMessage', {
    chat_id: chatId,
    text: 'â³',
    reply_markup: { remove_keyboard: true }
  });
  if (sent?.ok && sent?.result?.message_id) {
    await tgApiCall(token, 'deleteMessage', {
      chat_id: chatId,
      message_id: sent.result.message_id
    });
  }
}

// Ø§Ø±Ø³Ø§Ù„ ÛŒØ§ ÙˆÛŒØ±Ø§ÛŒØ´ Ø¯Ø±Ø¬Ø§ÛŒ ÛŒÚ© Ú©Ø§Ø±Øª Ø¯Ø± ØªÙ„Ú¯Ø±Ø§Ù…
async function sendOrEditCard(token, chatId, title, bodyHtml, inlineKeyboard, messageIdToEdit) {
  const text = title ? `<b>${title}</b>\n\n${bodyHtml}` : bodyHtml;
  const payload = {
    chat_id: chatId,
    text,
    parse_mode: 'HTML',
    disable_web_page_preview: true
  };
  if (inlineKeyboard && inlineKeyboard.length > 0) {
    payload.reply_markup = { inline_keyboard: inlineKeyboard };
  }

  if (messageIdToEdit) {
    const editRes = await tgApiCall(token, 'editMessageText', {
      ...payload,
      message_id: messageIdToEdit
    });
    if (editRes?.ok || (editRes?.description && editRes.description.includes('message is not modified'))) {
      return;
    }
  }

  await tgApiCall(token, 'sendMessage', payload);
}

# React + TypeScript + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some ESLint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the ESLint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend updating the configuration to enable type-aware lint rules:

```js

  globalIgnores(['dist']),
  {
    files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}'],
    extends: [
      // Other configs...

      // Remove tseslint.configs.recommended and replace with this
      tseslint.configs.recommendedTypeChecked,
      // Alternatively, use this for stricter rules
      tseslint.configs.strictTypeChecked,
      // Optionally, add this for stylistic rules
      tseslint.configs.stylisticTypeChecked,

      // Other configs...
    ],
    languageOptions: {
      parserOptions: {
        project: ['./tsconfig.node.json', './tsconfig.app.json'],
        tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname,
      },
      // other options...
    },
  },
])

```

You can also install [eslint-plugin-react-x](https://npmx.dev/package/eslint-plugin-react-x) and [eslint-plugin-react-dom](https://npmx.dev/package/eslint-plugin-react-dom) for React-specific lint rules:

  event.waitUntil(
    caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => {

const resolveEffectivePotShape = (
  shape: string,
  explicitPotShape?: PotShapeType | string
): PotShapeType => {
  if (explicitPotShape) {
    if (explicitPotShape === 'round') return 'round_smooth';
    if (explicitPotShape === 'hex') return 'faceted_gem';
    if (explicitPotShape === 'trough') return 'trough_fluted';
    return explicitPotShape as PotShapeType;
  }
  if (shape === 'combo_trough' || shape === 'combo_trough_2' || shape === 'dish_garden_succulent') {
    return 'trough_fluted';
  }
  if (shape.startsWith('bonsai_') || shape === 'ficus_ginseng' || shape === 'pine_nana') {
    return 'bonsai_tray';
  }
  if (shape.startsWith('pothos_') || shape.startsWith('string_of_')) {
    return 'hanging_basket';
  }
  if (shape.startsWith('sansevieria_') || shape.startsWith('zz_') || shape.startsWith('alocasia_')) {
    return 'cylinder_modern';
  }
  return 'round_smooth';
};

// ============================================================================

            <ellipse cx="50" cy="85.5" rx="13" ry="2.2" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.18)" />
            <path
              d="M33,54 C29,66 33,80 41,85 C44,86.5 56,86.5 59,85 C67,80 71,66 67,54 Z"
              fill={`url(#${gradId})`}
            />
            {renderTextureOverlay()}
            <path
              d="M33,54 A17,3.4 0 0,0 67,54 L67,55.5 A17,3.4 0 0,1 33,55.5 Z"
              fill={`url(#${rimGradId})`}
            />
          </g>
        );

      case 'footed_cauldron':
        return (
          <g>
            <ellipse cx="50" cy="84.5" rx="15" ry="2.2" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.16)" />
            <path d="M37,76 L35,84 L39,84 L41,77 Z" fill={palette.shadowHex} />
            <path d="M63,76 L65,84 L61,84 L59,77 Z" fill={palette.shadowHex} />
            <path d="M48.5,78 L48.5,84.5 L51.5,84.5 L51.5,78 Z" fill={palette.shadowHex} />
            <path
              d="M32,54 C30,66 35,78 50,78 C65,78 70,66 68,54 Z"
              fill={`url(#${gradId})`}
            />
            {renderTextureOverlay()}
            <path
              d="M31.5,54 A18.5,3.5 0 0,0 68.5,54 L68.5,55.6 A18.5,3.5 0 0,1 31.5,55.6 Z"
              fill={`url(#${rimGradId})`}
            />
          </g>
        );

      case 'lotus_scalloped':
        return (
          <g>
            <ellipse cx="50" cy="85" rx="14" ry="2.2" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.16)" />
            <path
              d="M30,54 C31,68 35,79 39,84 C42,85.5 58,85.5 61,84 C65,79 69,68 70,54 Q65,57.5 60,54.5 Q55,58 50,55 Q45,58 40,54.5 Q35,57.5 30,54 Z"
              fill={`url(#${gradId})`}
            />
            <g stroke={palette.shadowHex} strokeWidth="0.7" opacity="0.45" fill="none">
              <path d="M40,55 Q41,70 43,84.5" />
              <path d="M50,55.5 L50,85" />
              <path d="M60,55 Q59,70 57,84.5" />
            </g>
            {renderTextureOverlay()}
          </g>
        );

      case 'tiered_pagoda':
        return (
          <g>
            <ellipse cx="50" cy="85.5" rx="14" ry="2.2" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.18)" />
            <path d="M31,54 L32.5,64 L67.5,64 L69,54 Z" fill={`url(#${gradId})`} />
            <path d="M34.5,64 L36,74.5 L64,74.5 L65.5,64 Z" fill={`url(#${gradId})`} />
            <path d="M38,74.5 L39.5,85 L60.5,85 L62,74.5 Z" fill={`url(#${gradId})`} />
            <line x1="32.5" y1="64" x2="67.5" y2="64" stroke={palette.shadowHex} strokeWidth="1.2" />
            <line x1="36" y1="74.5" x2="64" y2="74.5" stroke={palette.shadowHex} strokeWidth="1.2" />
            {renderTextureOverlay()}
            <path
              d="M30.5,54 A19.5,3.5 0 0,0 69.5,54 L69.5,55.6 A19.5,3.5 0 0,1 30.5,55.6 Z"
              fill={`url(#${rimGradId})`}
            />
          </g>
        );

      case 'woven_belly':
        return (
          <g>
            <ellipse cx="50" cy="85.5" rx="15" ry="2.2" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.18)" />
            <path
              d="M33,54 L28,69 L36,84.5 C39,86 61,86 64,84.5 L72,69 L67,54 Z"
              fill={`url(#${gradId})`}
            />
            <line x1="28" y1="69" x2="72" y2="69" stroke={palette.shadowHex} strokeWidth="1.1" opacity="0.7" />
            <g stroke={palette.shadowHex} strokeWidth="0.65" opacity="0.45" fill="none">
              <path d="M32,59 L68,59" />
              <path d="M30,64 L70,64" />
              <path d="M31,74 L69,74" />
              <path d="M34,79 L66,79" />
              <path d="M38,55 L34,69 L39,84" />
              <path d="M46,55 L44,69 L46,85" />
              <path d="M54,55 L56,69 L54,85" />
              <path d="M62,55 L66,69 L61,84" />
            </g>
            <path d="M32,54 C29,50 35,49 36,54" stroke={palette.shadowHex} strokeWidth="1.4" fill="none" />
            <path d="M68,54 C71,50 65,49 64,54" stroke={palette.shadowHex} strokeWidth="1.4" fill="none" />
          </g>
        );

      case 'round_smooth':
      default:
        return (
          <g>
            <ellipse cx="50" cy="85" rx="16" ry="2.5" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.16)" />
            <path
              d="M31,54 C31,66 34,78 37,84 C39,85.8 61,85.8 63,84 C66,78 69,66 69,54 Z"
              fill={`url(#${gradId})`}
            />
            {renderTextureOverlay()}
            <path
              d="M30,54 A20,3.8 0 0,0 70,54 L70,56.2 A20,3.8 0 0,1 30,56.2 Z"
              fill={`url(#${rimGradId})`}
            />
          </g>
        );
    }
  };

  return (
    <g>
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id={gradId} x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="15%">
          <stop offset="0%" stopColor={palette.highlightHex} />
          <stop offset="35%" stopColor={palette.baseHex} />
          <stop offset="100%" stopColor={palette.shadowHex} />
        </linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id={rimGradId} x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
          <stop offset="0%" stopColor={palette.highlightHex} />
          <stop offset="50%" stopColor={palette.rimHex} />
          <stop offset="100%" stopColor={palette.shadowHex} />
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      {renderPotGeometry()}
    </g>
  );
};

const renderPointedBlade = (
  cx: number,
  cy: number,
  rx: number,
  ry: number,
  rot: number,
  outerFill: string,
  strokeColor: string,
  innerFill?: string,
  veinColor?: string,
  patternType?: 'silver_queen' | 'snow_dots' | 'red_edge' | 'pinstripe' | 'feather' | 'none'
) => (
  <g key={`${cx}_${cy}_${rot}`} transform={`rotate(${rot} ${cx} ${cy})`}>
    <path
      d={`M ${cx} ${cy - ry} C ${cx + rx * 1.25} ${cy - ry * 0.45}, ${cx + rx * 1.15} ${cy + ry * 0.55}, ${cx} ${cy + ry} C ${cx - rx * 1.15} ${cy + ry * 0.55}, ${cx - rx * 1.25} ${cy - ry * 0.45}, ${cx} ${cy - ry} Z`}
      fill={outerFill}
      stroke={strokeColor}
      strokeWidth="0.9"
    />
    {innerFill && (
      <path
        d={`M ${cx} ${cy - ry * 0.78} C ${cx + rx * 0.78} ${cy - ry * 0.3}, ${cx + rx * 0.72} ${cy + ry * 0.45}, ${cx} ${cy + ry * 0.8} C ${cx - rx * 0.72} ${cy + ry * 0.45}, ${cx - rx * 0.78} ${cy - ry * 0.3}, ${cx} ${cy - ry * 0.78} Z`}
        fill={innerFill}
        opacity="0.9"
      />
    )}
    {patternType === 'pinstripe' && (
      <g stroke="#F472B6" strokeWidth="0.85" strokeLinecap="round">
        <path d={`M ${cx - 1} ${cy - ry * 0.35} L ${cx - rx * 0.75} ${cy - ry * 0.55}`} />
        <path d={`M ${cx + 1} ${cy - ry * 0.35} L ${cx + rx * 0.75} ${cy - ry * 0.55}`} />
        <path d={`M ${cx - 1} ${cy + ry * 0.05} L ${cx - rx * 0.8} ${cy - ry * 0.15}`} />
        <path d={`M ${cx + 1} ${cy + ry * 0.05} L ${cx + rx * 0.8} ${cy - ry * 0.15}`} />
        <path d={`M ${cx - 1} ${cy + ry * 0.4} L ${cx - rx * 0.65} ${cy + ry * 0.2}`} />
        <path d={`M ${cx + 1} ${cy + ry * 0.4} L ${cx + rx * 0.65} ${cy + ry * 0.2}`} />
      </g>
    )}
    {patternType === 'feather' && (
      <g stroke="#A7F3D0" strokeWidth="1.2" strokeLinecap="round" opacity="0.85">
        <path d={`M ${cx} ${cy - ry * 0.3} L ${cx - rx * 0.7} ${cy - ry * 0.5}`} />
        <path d={`M ${cx} ${cy - ry * 0.3} L ${cx + rx * 0.7} ${cy - ry * 0.5}`} />
        <path d={`M ${cx} ${cy + ry * 0.1} L ${cx - rx * 0.75} ${cy - ry * 0.1}`} />
        <path d={`M ${cx} ${cy + ry * 0.1} L ${cx + rx * 0.75} ${cy - ry * 0.1}`} />
        <path d={`M ${cx} ${cy + ry * 0.45} L ${cx - rx * 0.6} ${cy + ry * 0.25}`} />
        <path d={`M ${cx} ${cy + ry * 0.45} L ${cx + rx * 0.6} ${cy + ry * 0.25}`} />
      </g>
    )}
    {patternType === 'snow_dots' && (
      <g fill={veinColor || '#FFFFFF'} opacity="0.85">
        <circle cx={cx - rx * 0.35} cy={cy - ry * 0.25} r="1.2" />
        <circle cx={cx + rx * 0.4} cy={cy - ry * 0.1} r="1.4" />
        <circle cx={cx - rx * 0.3} cy={cy + ry * 0.2} r="1.3" />
        <circle cx={cx + rx * 0.3} cy={cy + ry * 0.35} r="1.1" />
      </g>
    )}
    {veinColor && (
      <line
        x1={cx}
        y1={cy - ry * 0.75}
        x2={cx}
        y2={cy + ry * 0.88}
        stroke={veinColor}
        strokeWidth="1.05"
        strokeLinecap="round"
      />
    )}
  </g>
);

export const PlantStylizedIllustration: React.FC<{
  shape: string;
  potColor: PotColorType | string;
  potShape?: PotShapeType | string;
  plantName?: string;
  customSvgMarkup?: string;
}> = ({ shape, potColor, potShape, customSvgMarkup }) => {
  const effectivePotShape = resolveEffectivePotShape(shape, potShape);
  const palette = POT_COLOR_PALETTE[potColor] || POT_COLOR_PALETTE.white;

  if (customSvgMarkup && customSvgMarkup.trim().startsWith('data:image/')) {
    return (
      <div className="relative w-24 h-24 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-[#E8E2D5] bg-[#F6F3EC] shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center">
        <img
          src={customSvgMarkup}
          alt="plant studio"
          className="w-full h-full object-cover"
        />
        <div className="absolute inset-0 ring-1 ring-inset ring-black/5 rounded-2xl pointer-events-none" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (customSvgMarkup && customSvgMarkup.trim().startsWith('<svg')) {
    return (
      <div
        className="w-24 h-24 flex items-center justify-center drop-shadow-xs"
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: customSvgMarkup }}
      />
    );
  }

  // Ù„Ø§ÛŒÙ‡ Û±: Ø¯Ù‡Ø§Ù†Ù‡ Ù¾Ø´ØªÛŒ Ú¯Ù„Ø¯Ø§Ù† Ùˆ Ø¨Ø³ØªØ± Ø®Ø§Ú© ØªÛŒØ±Ù‡
  const renderBackRimAndSoil = () => {
    if (effectivePotShape === 'trough_fluted') {
      return (
        <g>
          <polygon points="24,54 30,51 76,51 72,56.5 24,56.5" fill={palette.insideHex} />
          <polygon points="26,54.2 31,51.8 74,51.8 70,56 26,56" fill="#4A3525" />
        </g>
      );
    }
    if (effectivePotShape === 'bonsai_tray') {
      return (
        <g>
          <polygon points="25,54 31,50.5 75,50.5 69,56.5 25,56.5" fill={palette.insideHex} />
          <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="21" ry="3.2" fill="#4A3525" />
        </g>
      );
    }
    const rx = effectivePotShape === 'bowl_saucer' ? 21.5 : 18;
    return (

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export type BotanicalDialogTone = 'success' | 'info' | 'warning' | 'danger';

interface DialogRequest {
  id: string;
  kind: 'alert' | 'confirm' | 'prompt';
  title: string;
  message: string;
  tone: BotanicalDialogTone;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  defaultValue?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  isPin?: boolean;
  resolve: (value: any) => void;
}

type DialogListener = (req: DialogRequest | null) => void;

let activeListener: DialogListener | null = null;
const requestQueue: DialogRequest[] = [];
let currentActiveRequest: DialogRequest | null = null;

const notifyNextInQueue = () => {
  if (currentActiveRequest || !activeListener) return;
  const next = requestQueue.shift() || null;
  currentActiveRequest = next;
  activeListener(next);
};

const enqueueDialog = (req: Omit<DialogRequest, 'id'>) => {
  const fullReq: DialogRequest = {
    ...req,
    id: 'dlg_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)
  };
  requestQueue.push(fullReq);
  notifyNextInQueue();
};

// Û±. Ø¬Ø§ÛŒÚ¯Ø²ÛŒÙ† Ø§Ø®ØªØµØ§ØµÛŒ alert() Ù…Ø±ÙˆØ±Ú¯Ø±
export const showBotanicalAlert = (params: {
  title: string;
  message: string;
  tone?: BotanicalDialogTone;
  confirmLabel?: string;
}): Promise<void> => {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    enqueueDialog({
      kind: 'alert',
      title: params.title,
      message: params.message,
      tone: params.tone || 'info',
      confirmLabel: params.confirmLabel || 'Ù…ØªÙˆØ¬Ù‡ Ø´Ø¯Ù… âœ“',
      resolve: () => resolve()
    });
  });
};

const normalizeNumericInput = (raw: string): string =>
  raw
    .replace(/[Û°-Û¹]/g, (d) => String('Û°Û±Û²Û³Û´ÛµÛ¶Û·Û¸Û¹'.indexOf(d)))
    .replace(/[Ù -Ù©]/g, (d) => String('Ù Ù¡Ù¢Ù£Ù¤Ù¥Ù¦Ù§Ù¨Ù©'.indexOf(d)))

const parsePositiveFloat = (val: string, fallback: number): number => {
  const num = parseFloat(normalizeNumericInput(val));
  return Number.isFinite(num) && num > 0 ? num : fallback;
};

const pickText = (...vals: Array<string | undefined | null>): string => {
  for (const v of vals) {
    if (typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length > 0) {
      return v.trim();
    }
  }
  return '';
};

const findMatchingCultivarGroup = (rawName: string, currentShape: string) => {
  if (currentShape === 'empty_pot_sprout') return null;
  const q = rawName.trim().toLowerCase();
  return (
    CULTIVAR_FAMILY_GROUPS.find(
      (grp) =>
        grp.exactShapes.includes(currentShape) ||
        (q.length >= 3 && grp.matchKeywords.some((kw) => q.includes(kw)))
    ) || null
  );
};

export const getDefaultMemberPermissions = (role: MemberRole): MemberPermissions => {
  switch (role) {
    case 'super_admin':
    case 'space_admin':
      return {
        canWaterAndMist: true,
        canEditPlants: true,
        canManageSpaces: true,
        canDelete: true
      };
    case 'caretaker':
      return {
        canWaterAndMist: true,
        canEditPlants: false,
        canManageSpaces: false,
        canDelete: false
      };
    case 'viewer':
    default:
      return {
        canWaterAndMist: false,
        canEditPlants: false,
        canManageSpaces: false,
        canDelete: false
      };
  }
};

export const formatPersianDate = (daysAgo: number = 0): string => {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - daysAgo);
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR-u-ca-persian', {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    year: 'numeric'
  }).format(d);
};

export const getAllEncyclopediaEntries = (): PlantEncyclopediaEntry[] => {
  const combined = [...SUPPLEMENTARY_VARIETIES, ...EXTERNAL_ENCYCLOPEDIA_PHASES];
  const seenNames = new Set<string>();
  return combined.filter((item) => {
    if (!item || !item.data || !item.data.name) return false;
    const key = item.data.name.trim();
    if (seenNames.has(key)) return false;
    seenNames.add(key);
    return true;
  });
};

export const PRESET_SPECIES_SUGGESTIONS: Array<{
  label: string;
  shape3D: string;
  isCombo?: boolean;
}> = getAllEncyclopediaEntries().map((entry) => ({
  label: entry.data.name,
  shape3D: entry.data.shape3D,
  isCombo: entry.data.shape3D.startsWith('combo_')
}));

const entryToSuggestion = (
  entry: PlantEncyclopediaEntry,
  matchReason?: string
): PlantSearchSuggestion => ({
  name: entry.data.name,
  sci: entry.data.sci,
  family: entry.data.family,
  nickname: entry.data.nickname,
  shape3D: entry.data.shape3D,
  waterCycleDays: entry.data.waterCycleDays,
  isSucculentOrCactus: entry.data.isSucculentOrCactus,
  recommendedPotShape: entry.data.recommendedPotShape as PotShapeType,
  recommendedPotColor: entry.data.recommendedPotColor as PotColorType,
  isCombo: entry.data.shape3D.startsWith('combo_'),
  matchReason
});

export const searchPlantEncyclopedia = (
  rawQuery: string,
  isComboPlanter: boolean = false,
  limit: number = 12
): PlantSearchSuggestion[] => {
  const allEntries = getAllEncyclopediaEntries();
  const q = rawQuery.trim().toLowerCase();

  if (!q) {
    return allEntries
      .filter((e) =>
        isComboPlanter
          ? e.data.shape3D.startsWith('combo_') || e.data.isSucculentOrCactus
          : true
      )
      .slice(0, limit)
      .map((e) => entryToSuggestion(e));

    .map((entry) => {
      const nameLower = entry.data.name.toLowerCase();
      const sciLower = entry.data.sci.toLowerCase();

export const copyTextSafe = async (text: string): Promise<boolean> => {
  try {
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      return true;
    }
  } catch {
    // Ø§Ø¯Ø§Ù…Ù‡ Ø¨Ù‡ Ø±ÙˆØ´ Ø¬Ø§ÛŒÚ¯Ø²ÛŒÙ†
  }

  try {
    const textArea = document.createElement('textarea');
    textArea.value = text;
    textArea.style.position = 'fixed';
    textArea.style.left = '-9999px';
    textArea.style.top = '0';
    document.body.appendChild(textArea);
    textArea.focus();
    textArea.select();
    const copied = document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(textArea);
    return copied;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
};

let supabaseInstance: SupabaseClient | null = null;

export const getSupabaseClient = (): SupabaseClient | null => {
  const cfg = getCloudConfig();
  if (!cfg.supabaseUrl || !cfg.supabaseAnonKey) return null;
  if (!supabaseInstance) {
    supabaseInstance = createClient(cfg.supabaseUrl, cfg.supabaseAnonKey);
  }
  return supabaseInstance;
};

export const fetchGreenhouseFromCloud = async (): Promise<GreenhouseCloudPayload | null> => {
  const client = getSupabaseClient();
  if (!client) return null;

  const { data, error } = await client
    .from('greenhouse_state')
    .select('payload')
    .eq('room_id', ROOM_ID)
    .single();

  if (error || !data?.payload) return null;

  if (data.payload.botSettings) {
    const currentCfg = getCloudConfig();
    const remoteBot = data.payload.botSettings;
    saveCloudConfig({
      ...currentCfg,
      telegramBotToken: pickStr(currentCfg.telegramBotToken, remoteBot.telegramBotToken),
      telegramChatId: pickStr(currentCfg.telegramChatId, remoteBot.telegramChatId),
      telegramBotUsername: pickStr(currentCfg.telegramBotUsername, remoteBot.telegramBotUsername)
    });
  }

  return data.payload as GreenhouseCloudPayload;
};

export const pushGreenhouseToCloud = async (payload: {
  spaces: SpaceEntity[];
  plants: PlantEntity[];
  gardens: GardenEntity[];
  members: MemberEntity[];
}): Promise<boolean> => {
  const client = getSupabaseClient();
  if (!client) return false;

  const cfg = getCloudConfig();
  const fullPayload = {
    ...payload,
    botSettings: {
      telegramBotToken: cfg.telegramBotToken,
      telegramChatId: cfg.telegramChatId,
      telegramBotUsername: cfg.telegramBotUsername
    }
  };

  const { error } = await client.from('greenhouse_state').upsert(
    {
      room_id: ROOM_ID,
      payload: fullPayload,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    },
    { onConflict: 'room_id' }
  );

  return !error;
};

export const fetchTelegramBotUsername = async (
  customToken?: string
): Promise<string | null> => {
  const cfg = getCloudConfig();
  const fallbackUsername = pickStr(cfg.telegramBotUsername);
  const token = pickStr(customToken, cfg.telegramBotToken);
  if (!token) return fallbackUsername || null;

  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 3500);

  try {
    const res = await fetch(
      `https://greenhouse-bot.sinafallah-ai.workers.dev/bot${token}/getMe`,
      { signal: controller.signal }
    );
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    if (!res.ok) return fallbackUsername || null;
    const data = await res.json();
    const username: string = pickStr(data?.result?.username);
    if (username) {
      saveCloudConfig({ ...cfg, telegramBotUsername: username });
      return username;
    }
    return fallbackUsername || null;
  } catch {
    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    return fallbackUsername || null;
  }
};

const cachedSubscribersMap = new Map<string, TelegramBotSubscriber>();

export const fetchRecentBotSubscribers = async (
  customToken?: string
): Promise<TelegramBotSubscriber[]> => {

  const token = pickStr(customToken, cfg.telegramBotToken);
  if (!token) return Array.from(cachedSubscribersMap.values());

  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 4000);

      `https://greenhouse-bot.sinafallah-ai.workers.dev/bot${token}/getUpdates?limit=30`,
      { signal: controller.signal }

const resolveTargetChatIds = (
  spaceId: string,
  members: MemberEntity[],
  mode: 'alerts' | 'actions'
): string[] => {
  const cfg = getCloudConfig();
  const targets = new Set<string>();

  members.forEach((m) => {
    if (!m.active) return;
    const chatId = pickStr(m.telegramChatId);
    if (!chatId) return;

    const isSuper = m.role === 'super_admin';
    const isAssigned = m.assignedSpaces.includes(spaceId);
    if (!isSuper && !isAssigned) return;

    if (mode === 'alerts' && m.notifyAlerts) targets.add(chatId);
    if (mode === 'actions' && m.notifyActions) targets.add(chatId);
  });

  const fallbackChatId = pickStr(cfg.telegramChatId);
  if (targets.size === 0 && fallbackChatId) {
    targets.add(fallbackChatId);
  }

  return Array.from(targets);
};

const answerCallbackQuery = async (
  token: string,
  callbackQueryId: string,
  text: string
): Promise<void> => {
  try {
    await fetch(
      `https://greenhouse-bot.sinafallah-ai.workers.dev/bot${token}/answerCallbackQuery`,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          callback_query_id: callbackQueryId,
          text,
          show_alert: false
        })
      }
    );
  } catch {

const findMemberByChatId = (
  chatId: string,
  members: MemberEntity[],
  defaultChatId: string
): MemberEntity | null => {
  const found = members.find((m) => m.active && pickStr(m.telegramChatId) === chatId);
  if (found) return found;
  if (defaultChatId && chatId === defaultChatId && members.length > 0) {
    return members[0];
  }
  return null;
};

export const APP_VERSION = '2.5.0';
export const SCHEMA_VERSION = 2;

// Ø±Ø§Ø¨Ø· Ø§Ø³ØªØ§Ù†Ø¯Ø§Ø±Ø¯ Ø±ÙˆÛŒØ¯Ø§Ø¯ Ù†ØµØ¨ PWA Ø¯Ø± Ù…Ø±ÙˆØ±Ú¯Ø±Ù‡Ø§ÛŒ Ø¯Ø³Ú©ØªØ§Ù¾ Ùˆ Ù…ÙˆØ¨Ø§ÛŒÙ„
export interface BeforeInstallPromptEvent extends Event {
  readonly platforms: string[];
  readonly userChoice: Promise<{
    outcome: 'accepted' | 'dismissed';
    platform: string;
  }>;
  prompt(): Promise<void>;
}

export interface VersionManifest {
  version: string;
  schemaVersion: number;
  releaseDate: string;
  changelog: string[];
  forceReload?: boolean;
}

let deferredInstallPrompt: BeforeInstallPromptEvent | null = null;
const installListeners = new Set<(canInstall: boolean) => void>();

// Ø«Ø¨Øª Ø´Ù†ÙˆÙ†Ø¯Ù‡ Ø±ÙˆÛŒØ¯Ø§Ø¯ Ù†ØµØ¨ PWA Ø±ÙˆÛŒ Ù…ÙˆØ¨Ø§ÛŒÙ„ (Ø§Ù†Ø¯Ø±ÙˆÛŒØ¯/iOS) Ùˆ Ø¯Ø³Ú©ØªØ§Ù¾ (ÙˆÛŒÙ†Ø¯ÙˆØ²/Ù…Ú©)
export function initPwaInstallListener(): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

  window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', (e: Event) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    deferredInstallPrompt = e as BeforeInstallPromptEvent;
    installListeners.forEach((cb) => cb(true));
  });

  window.addEventListener('appinstalled', () => {
    deferredInstallPrompt = null;
    installListeners.forEach((cb) => cb(false));
  });
}

export function subscribeToInstallAvailability(
  callback: (canInstall: boolean) => void
): () => void {
  installListeners.add(callback);
  callback(deferredInstallPrompt !== null);
  return () => {
    installListeners.delete(callback);
  };
}

export async function triggerPwaInstall(): Promise<'accepted' | 'dismissed' | 'unavailable'> {
  if (!deferredInstallPrompt) {
    return 'unavailable';
  }
  await deferredInstallPrompt.prompt();
  const choice = await deferredInstallPrompt.userChoice;
  if (choice.outcome === 'accepted') {
    deferredInstallPrompt = null;
    installListeners.forEach((cb) => cb(false));
  }
  return choice.outcome;
}

export function isRunningStandalonePwa(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  const isStandalone = window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches;
  const isIosStandalone = (window.navigator as Navigator & { standalone?: boolean }).standalone === true;
  return isStandalone || isIosStandalone;
}

export function getNotificationPermissionStatus(): NotificationPermission | 'unsupported' {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('Notification' in window)) {
    return 'unsupported';
  }
  return Notification.permission;
}

export async function requestNativeNotificationPermission(): Promise<
  NotificationPermission | 'unsupported'
> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('Notification' in window)) {
    return 'unsupported';
  }
  if (Notification.permission === 'granted') {
    return 'granted';
  }
  const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
  return permission;
}

export async function sendNativeNotification(params: {
  title: string;
  body: string;
  tag?: string;
}): Promise<boolean> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('Notification' in window)) {
    return false;
  }
  if (Notification.permission !== 'granted') {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
      const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration();
      if (registration) {
        await registration.showNotification(params.title, {
          body: params.body,
          tag: params.tag || 'botanica-care-alert',
          dir: 'rtl',
          lang: 'fa-IR',
          icon: '/botanica-icon.svg',
          badge: '/botanica-icon.svg'
        });
        return true;
      }
    }

    new Notification(params.title, {
      body: params.body,
      tag: params.tag || 'botanica-care-alert',
      dir: 'rtl',
      lang: 'fa-IR'
    });
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Native notification dispatch error:', err);
    return false;
  }
}

export async function checkForRemoteAppUpdate(): Promise<VersionManifest | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/version.json?t=${Date.now()}`, {
      cache: 'no-store'
    });
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    const manifest = (await res.json()) as VersionManifest;
    if (manifest.version && manifest.version !== APP_VERSION) {
      return manifest;
    }
    return null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function applyAppUpdateAndReload(): Promise<void> {
  if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
    const registrations = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations();
    for (const reg of registrations) {
      await reg.update();
      if (reg.waiting) {
        reg.waiting.postMessage({ type: 'SKIP_WAITING' });
      }
    }
  }
  if ('caches' in window) {
    const keys = await caches.keys();
    await Promise.all(keys.map((key) => caches.delete(key)));
  }
  window.location.reload();
}
